name: banana-math-puzzle
description: Banana Math Puzzle Challenge, a full-stack educational puzzle game.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.postman: node postman/build-collection.mjs && npx --yes newman run postman/banana-math.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 30000
